Theme

Latin word

medius

medius, media, medium

adjective

average, mean (of figures); in the middle; the middle of; neutral, undecided; the middle of: the middle of the night, of the road; round the middle, by the waist

In this lexicon

  • average

    the recommended word · modern · M-O s.v. average: valor medius, numerus medius; average temperature, calor medius (Gauss)

  • centre

    the recommended word · classical · Phaedr. 3.14.5: in mediā viā; Plaut. Curc. 4.1.14: in forō mediō (Lewis & Short); Traupman 288

  • neutral

    also used · classical · Cic. Att. 10.8.4: mediōs esse (Lewis & Short); Liv. 2.27: medium sē gerere (Lewis & Short)

  • the top of

    the recommended word · classical · Gell. 3.2.2: ā mediā nocte ad proximam mediam noctem

  • waist

    also used · classical · Liv. 23.9.9: juvenem medium complectitur (Lewis & Short); Ter. Ad. 3.2.18: medium arripere aliquem (Lewis & Short)

  • medius fidius: by Hercules!

    classical

  • digitus medius: index finger

    classical

  • arcum retēnsum posuit in mediā viā

    he laid the unstrung bow down in the middle of the roadPhaedr. 3.14.5

    In the entry for centre

    in the middle is a white honeycombOv. Met. 8.677

    In the entry for centre
